population.summary: Adults with severe aplastic anemia who had an insufficient response to at least one course of ATG-based immunosuppressive therapy and who have a platelet count ≤ 30 × 10^9/L

inclusion.text: Age ≥ 18 years at the time of informed consent

inclusion.src: USER（重症、網赤血球 < 20,000/µL を確認 2026-10-25）+ PRIOR:NDA22291-S021:summary-review

inclusion.text: Insufficient response to at least one course of ATG-based immunosuppressive therapy (horse or rabbit ATG with or without cyclosporine)
TPO 受容体作動薬（TPO-RA）の治療歴は問わない。治療歴がある場合は、TPO-RA に不応又は不耐であったことが診療録で確認できること

inclusion.text: Adequate organ function: ALT and AST ≤ 3 × ULN; total bilirubin < 1.5 × ULN; serum creatinine ≤ 2.0 mg/dL
inclusion.src: CTG:NCT02773290 (thresholds split across trials; options in pack)

inclusion.text: Not eligible for, or declines, hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, and no HSCT planned within 1 year
Agreement to use contraception for the duration specified in Section 5 ([TBD: period after last dose based on half-life])

exclusion.text: Congenital bone marrow failure syndrome (e.g., Fanconi anemia, dyskeratosis congenita)
Cytogenetic abnormality in bone marrow (G-banding or FISH for -7/7q-), bone marrow blasts > 2%, or reticulin fibrosis grade ≥ 2; diagnosis of MDS or AML
PNH granulocyte clone ≥ 50% or hemolysis-predominant PNH
Infection not adequately responding to appropriate therapy
Arterial or venous thrombosis within 1 year, ongoing anticoagulant therapy, or antiphospholipid syndrome
Clinically significant cardiac disease (NYHA class III–IV, myocardial infarction within 6 months, clinically significant arrhythmia)
Malignancy within 5 years except adequately treated localized tumors
HIV antibody positive, HBs antigen positive, or HCV RNA positive
History of severe hypersensitivity to monoclonal antibodies or other therapeutic proteins, or to any component of XYZ-531

response_definitions.hematologic_response: 次の 1 項目以上を満たす: (1) 血小板反応 — 血小板数がベースラインから 20 × 10^9/L 以上増加、又は血小板輸血非依存で 8 週間以上安定した血小板数; (2) 赤血球反応（ベースラインのヘモグロビン < 9 g/dL の参加者）— 赤血球輸血なしでヘモグロビンが 1.5 g/dL を超えて増加、又は投与前 8 週間と比べて連続 8 週間の赤血球輸血が 4 単位以上減少; (3) 好中球反応（ベースラインの ANC < 0.5 × 10^9/L の参加者）— ANC が 100% 以上増加、又は 0.5 × 10^9/L を超えて増加
response_definitions.exclusion_window: Values measured within [TBD] days after platelet transfusion, within [TBD] days after RBC transfusion, or during G-CSF use are not used to assess response
response_definitions.src: PRIOR:NDA22291-S021:label-14.3 + CTG:NCT00922883 (verbatim match) + PRIOR:NDA22291-S021:clinical-review-p41 (growth factor/transfusion not counted)

dlt_definition.text: Any of the following events occurring during the DLT evaluation period and assessed as at least possibly related to XYZ-531: (a) Grade ≥ 3 non-hematologic TEAE (CTCAE v6.0), except Grade 3 nausea, vomiting or diarrhea resolving to ≤ Grade 1 within [TBD] days with supportive care; (b) any thromboembolic event; (c) ALT or AST > [TBD] × ULN, or ALT or AST > 3 × ULN with total bilirubin > 1.5 × ULN (concurrent); (d) platelet count > 400 × 10^9/L; (e) Grade ≥ 3 hypersensitivity or injection-site reaction; (f) new bone marrow cytogenetic abnormality or increase in bone marrow blasts; (g) any other toxicity judged dose-limiting by the Safety Review Committee. Worsening of cytopenias attributable to the underlying aplastic anemia is not a DLT unless the Safety Review Committee judges otherwise.
dlt_definition.src: STD (FIH) + PRIOR:NDA22291-S021:label-6.1 (ALT/AST > 3 × ULN with total bilirubin > 1.5 × ULN; new cytogenetic abnormality) + PRIOR:NDA22291-S021:label-2.3 Table 7 (> 400 × 10^9/L) + DERIVED

dose_modification.condition: Platelet count 200 × 10^9/L to 400 × 10^9/L at any time
dose_modification.action: Reduce to the next lower dose level (or extend the interval) [DERIVED]
Withhold XYZ-531 until platelet count < 150 × 10^9/L, then resume at the next lower dose level
dose_modification.src: PRIOR:NDA22291-S021:label-2.3 Table 7 (thresholds) + DERIVED (antibody: withhold the next dose rather than 1 week)

dose_modification.action: Withhold XYZ-531; resume at the same or lower dose only after ALT/AST < 5 × ULN and Medical Monitor agreement
Discontinue XYZ-531 (consider; Safety Review Committee review)
